summary: Methanex Corporation filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes a net loss of $14 million, adjusted EBITDA of $220 million, and an average realized price of $351 per tonne. The company also notes repayment of $60 million on Term Loan A and $14 million returned to shareholders via dividends. There is no mention of any special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation implications.
